reason: This PR changes core parser grammar and keyword handling (`parser.y`, generated parser, keywords, AST/model) for new SQL/DDL syntax, and also touches DDL execution paths (`create_table.go`, `executor.go`). Even if scoped to columnar index support, parser SQL semantics and DDL behavior are central, high-blast-radius areas where subtle Blocker/High issues can hide in syntax compatibility, AST shape, and create-table/index execution.
